ROUTE: Whimbrel-235B
REASON: My choice came down to task fit. The query asks the model to pull evidence from supplied primary sources and a video clip and synthesize them into an explanatory paragraph—that's fundamentally an extraction-and-retrieval plus summarization task. Whimbrel scores 81.6 on Extraction & Retrieval versus Willet's 78.5, a gap just past the 2.0-point variance threshold, so it's a meaningful edge. On the other dimensions (summarization, general benchmarks) the two models are effectively tied, and the historical civil rights content is benign, so Willet's strong creative-generation advantage and its harm-aversion profile don't come into play. Net result: Whimbrel is the marginally better fit.
